Title: Nikhil's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Nikhil - 11 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Sunita - 36 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Vimla - 62 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Nikhil stands in the living room. Sunita stands near him.]

Nikhil: "Mom, what's the plan today?"

[Nikhil sweeps the floor with a broom.]

Nikhil: "Mom, listen!"

[Nikhil mops the floor.]

Sunita (softly): "Exactly right."

[Nikhil irons his school shirt.]

Nikhil: "That was such a fun day!"
